def reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation):
    """
    Reverse elements while keeping each punctuation mark
    associated with its original element.
    """
    if len(elements) != len(punctuation):
        raise ValueError("elements and punctuation must have the same length")

    pairs = list(zip(elements, punctuation))
    reversed_pairs = pairs[::-1]

    new_elements = [word for word, symbol in reversed_pairs]
    new_punctuation = [symbol for word, symbol in reversed_pairs]

    return new_elements, new_punctuation


# Example
elements = ["Hello", "world"]
punctuation = ["", "!"]

print(reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation))
# (["world", "Hello"], ["!", ""])
